scopeExpansion.summary: Nine verified 2026 briefs were added after targeted searches of guideline issuers, drug labels, clinical journals, trial records and official conference/sponsor reports. This is a selected backfill of material developments, not a completed month-by-month audit of every general AD source category. The original biomarker audit below retains its own scope and dates.
verificationNotes: Source dates use publication or regulatory-action dates; September 2 WHO executive summary and May CELIA topline release are supporting records, not duplicate briefs.
ARIA workgroup recommendations are labeled consensus, not a formal CPG. FDA labeling remains distinct.
EVOKE numerical tables were verified in the sponsor’s publication deck; primary-publication metadata was verified in the indexed abstract.
NICE 2026 draft appraisals were discovered but full primary documents were not retrievable; no final recommendation or coverage change is asserted.
Small pilots, narrative reviews and 2024–2025 guidance without a verified 2026 change were not added as new developments.
